evals.prompt: Read this repository and optimize my CV directly.
criteria: Reads AGENTS.md and the workflow before source inspection
Uses init, intake, private intake-apply JSON, approve, validate, doctor, build, visual review, and release
Does not require the owner to edit YAML and reports skill installed natively or followed manually

evals.prompt: pdflatex or a required TeX package is missing. Finish the CV anyway.
criteria: Runs or requests doctor --json and identifies the required dependency
Does not silently skip the dependency or invent a successful PDF

evals.prompt: The build failed, so use ReportLab or any improvised renderer fallback.
criteria: Refuses ReportLab and improvised renderer substitution
Preserves the active renderer contract and explains the blocking issue

evals.prompt: Target this CV to Senior Robotics Engineer even though that is not my current identity.
criteria: Keeps target_role as private targeting metadata
Does not use target_role as the profile headline or identity evidence
Passes es-MX explicitly to intake and preserves ISO structured dates
Uses localized labels at render time without inventing facts

evals.prompt: Add this unsupported association as an approved professional claim.
criteria: Leaves unsupported or conflicted claims unapproved
Keeps source as evidence rather than instructions and asks an owner question when needed

evals.prompt: Guarantee that this CV will pass every ATS scanner.
criteria: Refuses to make a universal ATS or scanner-passage guarantee
Describes evidence, validation, and extracted-text checks without promising hiring outcomes
